main.description: An account's unset.sh profile page: the identity column and the order of its cards. One per account; its presence means the account uses unset.sh, and deleting it removes the page.

displayName.description: Name shown at the top of the page. Absent means readers show the handle.

headline.description: One line shown under the name.

avatar.description: Profile picture. Readers crop it to a square.

avatarShape.description: How readers crop the avatar. Absent or unknown means round.

location.description: A place, as free text the member writes. Not a precise location.

website.description: The member's website. An http or https URL; readers ignore any other scheme.

visibility.description: Who apps should show the page to. Absent means public; an unknown value means owner-only. A request to apps, not access control: the record stays public.

listed.description: True asks directories to list the page. Absent or false means not listed; the page is still reachable at its address.

cards.description: The cards shown on the page, in display order. Only the cards named here are shown: a card not named here is not shown, a reference to a missing card is skipped, and a card named more than once is shown once, at its first place.

createdAt.description: When the profile was first created.

cardRef.description: One place in the page order.

uri.description: at:// address of an sh.unset.card record, written with the DID. Readers accept only a card record in this profile's own repository, named by that DID, and skip any other entry (a handle-form address, another account, another kind of record).
